    "Increase the line-height slightly on large uppercase headings so diacritics like 'Š' and 'Č' do not collide with the text line above them.",
    "Balance the desktop layout in the 'Vlečna služba' and 'Od klica do popravila' sections by arranging the steps in a horizontal 4-column grid and adding a callout or photo beside the towing text.",
    "Use a standard badge style for the euro prices in the 'Cene' section instead of repeating the license-plate EU strip, keeping the license plate motif exclusive to the phone number."
